contentPattern.structure: date eyebrow + heading + intro paragraph + image + caption

suitableFor: press release headers with date + title + lead + side image
editorial pages needing a two-up hero (text beside captioned image)
notSuitableFor: landing/hub promotional hero with CTAs (use columns-media-copy or cards-news)
text-only page title bands with no image

notes: Two-up article hero (c27-article-page-hero). Text column: first bare paragraph before the H1 is styled as an uppercase date/eyebrow; H1 headline; intro paragraph. Media column: hero image plus an italic caption paragraph. Base vanilla hero is a full-bleed background hero; this variant reworks it into a side-by-side article header, so JS and CSS were rewritten rather than copied verbatim.
